GAMMA DOCS

How it works.

GAMMA is a Solana token connected to a protocol-owned options treasury. The mechanism puts all fees received from trading on Meteora into 7-day call spreads on BTC, SOL, HYPE and ZEC through Paradex, then directs all net realized trading profits to GAMMA buybacks.

THE MECHANISM

From fees to buybacks.

01

Launch and trade on Meteora

GAMMA launches on Solana through Meteora. A share of the trading fees received by the protocol is collected by the treasury.

02

Build the treasury

All fees received by the protocol remain protocol-owned and are allocated to the next 7-day trading cycle.

03

Open four call spreads

The treasury uses Paradex to open 7-day call spreads across BTC, SOL, HYPE and ZEC. Each spread uses the same expiry for both option legs.

04

Buy back GAMMA

All net realized trading profits are allocated to buy GAMMA from the open market. Buybacks occur only when the treasury realizes a net trading profit.

THE STRATEGY

One defined-risk weekly trade.

For each market, the treasury buys a call at a lower strike and sells a call at a higher strike. Both calls expire in 7 days. The sold call lowers the cost of the position, while the bought call covers it. That creates a defined maximum loss and a capped maximum profit.

BTC SOL HYPE ZEC
BELOW THE LOWER STRIKE

Maximum loss

The spread can expire worthless. The maximum loss is the net premium paid.

BETWEEN THE STRIKES

Value rises

The spread gains value as the market moves above the lower strike.

ABOVE THE UPPER STRIKE

Maximum profit

The upside is capped once the market reaches the higher strike.

All collected fees are put at risk in this strategy. If every spread expires worthless, the fees allocated to that cycle can be lost. Buybacks happen only from net realized trading profits.

TREASURY POLICY

Owned by the protocol.

Profit goes to buybacks

Net realized trading profits are allocated to protocol-directed GAMMA buybacks, not paid out to individual holders.

No promised return

Holding GAMMA does not create ownership of treasury assets or a promise of income, distributions or returns.

Trading has risk

The strategy has defined risk, but it can still lose the entire net premium paid. A buyback is not guaranteed and does not guarantee any market outcome.

GAMMA stays on Solana

GAMMA remains a Solana token. The treasury uses Paradex only for its options positions.

PLATFORMS

Built with existing markets.

Meteora provides GAMMA’s Solana launch and trading market. Paradex provides the options venue used by the protocol treasury. GAMMA is independent from and not affiliated with either platform.
